statement: The scaffold has no `.gitignore`, so the adoption of a fresh scaffold commits `overview.index.json`; the developer's own memory repository ignores `onboarding/**/overview.index.json` (commits `17bc5d512`, `e7a572db4`). A derived file is committed in every new project. `kernel/memory_init.py` is in the scope of MIK-R46 (L46), which waits for L45.
